prompt.alinti: AI can now build animated websites with real physics.
Instead of stiff robotic movement, everything slows down, bounces, and settles like it would in real life.
It comes with seven ready-made examples, each a single page that runs on its own, so you can see the motion and copy it.
You install it into your AI coding setup in one step, and it automatically checks each animation to catch the lifeless kind that looks machine-made.
Build motion-first, high-touch creative websites on vanilla Three.js/ Canvas2D/WebGL/CSs.
motion-web is a code-first, motion-driven creative web engineering skill. It treats motion as the core material of the interface rather than an after-the-fact decoration.
Every case and blueprint enforces real physical laws (spring-damper systems, anisotropic forces, stepped jitter causal ecosystems) and zero placeholder code.
All cases come with automated Playwright headless verification oracles (verify_case.py) to mathematically prevent AI slop, synthetic drifts, and dead interactions.
Seven ready-made examples you can copy.
